name: Paaknam
instructions: 1. Mix the gram flour, onions, ginger, garlic, salt, turmeric, and chopped local herbs with a little water to form a thick, consistency-rich batter.
2. Prepare the banana leaves by lightly wilting them over an open flame to make them pliable.
3. Place a portion of the batter in the center of a prepared banana leaf.
4. Fold the leaf into a rectangular packet, securing it if necessary.
5. Cook the packets on a hot flat griddle or tava over medium heat, flipping occasionally until the leaf is charred and the inside is cooked through.
description: Paaknam is a beloved Manipuri snack often referred to as a traditional pancake. Its unique flavor profile comes from the distinct aroma of indigenous herbs and the smoky fragrance imparted by the banana leaves during the slow-griddling process.
